reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount and findOrCreateBank, and the guard is one shared function, but the holder release re-codes unlinkAccount's field clearing and the download function copies downloadAkahuTransactions.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, and the replacedAccountIds loop in linkBankSyncAccount repeats the db.updateAccount block from unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Guard and release live in accounts/app.ts next to the link helper, download in sync.ts and the base path in server-config.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; the 'fintegra' sync source is bolted onto AccountSyncSource as a literal instead of the provider list.

maintainability.why: The guard is centralised, but two copies (unlink fields, provider download) and a sync-source type that bypasses SYNC_PROVIDERS will drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: types/models/account.ts adds 'fintegra' to AccountSyncSource directly instead of to SYNC_PROVIDERS/BankSyncProviders; linkBankSyncAccount clears holders with its own db.updateAccount instead of sharing unlinkAccount's local-unlink logic.

abstraction_drift.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere takes a replaceExistingLink flag and linkBankSyncAccount a replacedAccountIds list; processBankSyncDownload gains a fintegra case in the akahu branch; the holder release in linkBankSyncAccount and the AccountSyncSource literal bypass existing unlink logic and the provider list.
